theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_tda_im_median_exists
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (F : Set α) (a : ℝ) (u : α → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < a → μ F = ENNReal.ofReal a → Measurable u → (∀ x, ∃ k : ℤ, u x = k) → ∃ β : ℤ, ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | u x ≤ β}) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | (β : ℝ) ≤ u x})
